rules.statement: The Crown has not expressly or impliedly agreed to be bound by all the terms of the Schedule Rules of the Privy Council Ordinance, and laches cannot be imputed to the Crown.
rules.supporting_quote: 'I would accordingly hold that, although there has been, in the circumstances of this case, a lack of due diligence on the part of the officers of the Crown, laches cannot be imputed to the Crown; and, therefore, that the provisions of Schedule Rule 25 do not apply to the Crown.'
